'''Decapitator disks''' were a bladed throwing-weapon used by the [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] around [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]]. In the [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] against Plagueis, a decapitator disk severed Plagueis of the right side of his [[Mouth/Legends|jaw]] and neck, his [[trachea]], and many blood vessels. After the attack Plagueis was required to wear a [[Transpirator/Legends|Transpirator]] for the rest of his life to breathe.
